Title: Disaster recovery of Azure Disk Encryption-enabled virtual machines

Body.Content:
Azure Site Recovery now supports disaster recovery for Azure Disk Encryption-enabled virtual machines without Azure Active Directory app. Replicate virtual machines enabled for encryption without Azure Active Directory app from one Azure region to another. This feature currently supports only Windows VMs using managed disks. Support for Linux VMs using managed disks will be available soon. 

For more details, read the announcement blog post and the documentation.
